---
title: "Vegetation Layer D (Moss/Lichen)"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
veg <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM vw_USysAllVeg WHERE PlotNumber = ?",
  list(params$plot_number)
)

dbDisconnect(con)

layer_col <- NULL
for (candidate in c("MyLayer", "layer", "layer_code")) {
  if (candidate %in% names(veg)) {
    layer_col <- candidate
    break
  }
}
```

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r veg-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(layer_col) && nrow(veg) > 0) {
  veg <- veg[veg[[layer_col]] == "D", , drop = FALSE]
  desired <- c("PlotNumber", layer_col, "Species", "CoverValue", "HeightValue")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(veg))
  view <- veg[, cols, drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(view) > 0) {
    kbl(view, align = "l") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No layer D records found.")
  }
} else {
  cat("Layer field not available in vw_USysAllVeg.")
}
```
